title: People Making Conversation: Evaluating How Naturally Speech Models Converse
abstract: arXiv:2610.12802v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A conversational speech model has to decide, at every pause, whether to speak. Existing evaluations test boundary detection, policy adherence, or aggregate statistics, not this decision. We place real-time speech systems at 427 pauses and 482 turn ends from 176 unscripted conversations in Seamless Interaction, give each the conversation so far, and score what it generates against what the person did: whether and how soon it speaks at a pause; its latency, length, and wording at a turn end; and whether it can answer a question about the preceding 30 to 120 seconds. Across six systems, the hosted APIs (GPT Realtime, Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, Grok Voice) respond at almost every pause whichever endpointer they use; only their latency, about 1 to 4 s with silence-based endpointers and about 8 s with semantic turn detection, decides whether the words land inside the pause. translated_title: 人类对话：评估语音模型对话的自然程度
translated_abstract: 对话式语音模型必须在每个停顿处决定是否开口说话。现有的评估方法测试的是边界检测、策略遵循或聚合统计，而非这一决策本身。我们将实时语音系统置于来自 Seamless Interaction 数据集中 176 段非脚本对话的 427 个停顿和 482 个话轮结束处，为每个系统提供目前为止的完整对话内容，并将其生成的内容与真人实际行为进行对比评分：它在停顿处是否开口以及多快开口；它在话轮结束时的延迟、长度和措辞；以及它能否回答关于此前 30 到 120 秒内容的问题。在六个系统中，托管 API（GPT Realtime、Gemini 3.1 Flash Live、Grok Voice）无论使用哪种端点检测器，几乎在每个停顿处都会响应；只有它们的延迟——使用基于静音的端点检测器时约为 1 到 4 秒，使用语义话轮检测时约为 8 秒——决定了话语是否能落在停顿之内。全双工模型（PersonaPlex、Moshi）是唯一能够……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的评估方法，将实时语音系统置于真实对话的停顿和话轮结束点，通过对比模型行为与真人实际表现来衡量语音模型“何时开口说话”这一决策的自然程度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new evaluation that places real-time speech systems at actual pauses and turn ends from unscripted conversations, scoring their speak-or-wait decisions against human behavior to measure conversational naturalness.
